devices.title: Device connections
devices.desc: When a device connects or disconnects. Quick reconnects within a few seconds are ignored.

crashes.title: App crashes

system.denied: Notifications are turned off for Tether
system.deniedHint: Allow them in the system notification settings, then try again.

tray.title: Tray icon
tray.desc: Connected devices at a glance, a quick screenshot and Open / Quit.
